armySpecialRules.name: THE LANCE FORMATION
armySpecialRules.description:
Any Cavalry unit with this special rule may deploy in the Lance Formation and/or reform into it during the game. A unit in Lance Formation follow the rules for Ranks that apply to Monstrous Cavalry. In effect, if by any means a unit of Bretonnian Knights is formed into a unit three models wide, it is treated as being in Lance Formation. Note that if a unit is ever wider than three models, it no longer counts as being in Lance Formation. In addition to this, the unit may form a unit up to 5 ranks deep.
A Wizard may be placed in the centre of the second rank of the Lance Formation rather than the front rank. Note that she remains fully in play even if she is not in the front rank (so the unit may use her Leadership, she may cast magic, etc.). If a second Wizard joins the unit, she may be placed in the centre of the third rank. If the rank in front of the Wizard ever falls below three models, she will move forward to take up the empty space. A Wizard in the second rank still counts as having line of sight for the purpose of casting spells. When casting a direct damage or magical vortex spell that originates from the Wizard's base, draw this spell from the base of the model in front of the Wizard instead.
On a turn that a unit in Lance Formation makes a successful charge, all models with this special rule gain the Fight in Extra Ranks (1) special rule, and every rider that gets to fight can make up to 2 Supporting Attacks rather than 1. In addition, they count each of their ranks as double for the purpose of determining whether they are Steadfast in turns that they charge.

armySpecialRules.name: THE BLESSING OF THE LADY
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule have the Magical Ward (6+) special rule. This is increased to Magical Ward (5+) against missile attacks. Models with the Grail Vow always have a Magical Ward (5+). Models with the Blessing of the Lady will lose it if they flee for any reason or refuse a challenge.

armySpecialRules.name: CHIVALROUS VOWS
armySpecialRules.description: Many units in the Bretonnian army have one of the following Vows:

armySpecialRules.name: The Knight's Vow
armySpecialRules.description: Models with the Knight's Vow have Immunity (Panic) caused by friendly models without a Chivalrous Vow. In addition, they may only join units with the Knight's Vow.

armySpecialRules.name: The Crusader's Vow
armySpecialRules.description: Models with the Crusader's Vow have Immunity (Panic) caused by friendly models without a Chivalrous Vow and may re-roll failed Panic tests. In addition, they may only join units with the Knight's Vow or the Crusader's Vow. Furthermore, a character with the Crusader Vow allows any unit they join to roll an additional D6 for their charge distance roll and discard the lowest result.

armySpecialRules.name: The Questing Vow
armySpecialRules.description: Models with the Questing's Vow have Immunity (Panic) caused by friendly models without a Chivalrous Vow and may re-roll failed Psychology tests. In addition, they may only join units with the Knight's Vow, the Crusader's Vow or the Questing Vow. Furthermore, they ignore Initiative penalties from using great weapons in any turn that they charge, but they may not use a heavy lance (unless specified).

armySpecialRules.name: The Grail Vow
armySpecialRules.description: Models with the Grail Vow gain +1 Weapon Skill and Attacks (if taken as an upgrade), as well as the Immunity (Psychology) and Magical Attacks special rules. In addition, they may only join units with the Knight's Vow, the Crusader's Vow, the Questing Vow or the Grail Vow. Furthermore, characters with the Grail Vow add +1 to their Leadership.

armySpecialRules.name: THE PEASANT'S DUTY
armySpecialRules.description: Models with the Peasant's Duty treat all friendly models with a Chivalrous Vow as having the Inspiring Presence (6) special rule. In addition, unit standards in units with the Peasant’s Duty do not confer any additional victory points if captured. Characters with the Peasant's Duty may not join units that have a Chivalrous Vow.

armySpecialRules.name: PUREBRED WARHORSE
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule do not suffer any movement penalties for being barded.

magicItems.name: SILVER LANCE OF THE BLESSED
magicItems.description: If the model has the Blessing of the Lady, then all attacks with the Silver Lance of the Blessed automatically hit. In addition, all successful enemy armour saves and Magical Wards must be re-rolled. However, if the model wielding the lance flees for any reason, he suffers D6 Flaming Strength 4 hits with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: DRAGON SLAYING SWORD
magicItems.description: The wielder gains the Multiple Wounds (D6) special rule against Draconids.

magicItems.name: CRUSADER'S LANCE
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder the Devastating Charge and Hatred special rules.

magicItems.name: SWORD OF HEROES
magicItems.description: Against enemies that have Toughness 5 or greater, the bearer gets +2 Strength and the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: WYRMLANCE
magicItems.description: The wielder of the Wyrmlance gains a Strength 3 Breath Weapon with the Flaming Attacks special rule. In addition, all attacks made with the Wyrmlance have the Flaming Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: BIRTH-SWORD OF CARCASSONNE
magicItems.description: The Birth-sword of Carcassonne gives +1 Strength to the wielder. Enemies wounded by the sword must re- roll successful armour saves.

magicItems.name: SWORD OF THE QUEST
magicItems.description: The Sword of the Quest may be used as either a hand weapon or a great weapon, decided at the start of each round combat. All attacks made by the Sword of the Quest have the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: HEARTWOOD LANCE
magicItems.description: The Heartwood Lance allows the bearer to re-roll all failed rolls to wound.

magicItems.name: FRONTIER AXE
magicItems.description: All attacks made with this weapon have the Multiple Wounds (2) special rule.

magicItems.name: THE VIRTUOUS LANCE
magicItems.description: This lance gives the wielder the Mighty Blow (1) and Multiple Wounds (D3) special rules when charging. When fighting Monstrous Creatures and Monsters, once you have established how many wounds have been inflicted, roll a D6 and add the number of wounds caused to the score. If the total is equal to 6 or more, remove the model as a casualty. Note that the wielder must cause at least one unsaved Wound for this rule to take effect.

magicItems.name: FOEBREAKER
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder +1 Strength. Any enemy Character or Lone Model that suffers one or more unsaved wounds from the Foebreaker suffer a -1 penalty Weapon Skill and Attacks (to a minimum of 1) until the end of the next round of Close Combat.

magicItems.name: LANCE OF ARTOIS
magicItems.description: The Lance of Artois gives the wielder the Killing Blow special rule on turns in which the character charges.

magicItems.name: SWORD OF THE LADY'S CHAMPION
magicItems.description: The character always counts their Strength as one higher than their target's Toughness, unless their Strength would normally be more than this.

magicItems.name: SWORD OF THE STOUT HEARTED
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder the Immunity (Psychology) special rule.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF THE MIDSUMMER SUN
magicItems.description: Opponents suffer a -1 penalty To Hit the wearer of the Armour of the Midsummer Sun with both missile and close combat attacks.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF AGILULF
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Armour of Agilulf gains Weapon Skill 10, but may not use a weapon that Requires Two Hands.

magicItems.name: CUIRASS OF FORTUNE
magicItems.description: The Knight may re-roll 1's when rolling To Hit, To Wound and when making armour saves.

magicItems.name: ANOINTED ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour may re-roll failed Magical Ward saves as long as they have the Blessing of the Lady.

magicItems.name: GROMRIL GREAT HELM
magicItems.description: The Gromril Great Helm gives the wearer a 6+ armour save and allows them to re-roll failed armour saves.

magicItems.name: GILDED CUIRASS
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Gilded Cuirass gains the Regeneration (6+) special rule.

magicItems.name: HELM OF THE DRAGON SLAYER
magicItems.description: This armour gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. In addition, the Ward Save from the Blessing of the Lady is increased to 5+ against close combat attacks and the wearer gains the Immunity (Flaming Attacks) special rule.

magicItems.name: THE GRAIL SHIELD
magicItems.description: The wearer gains +1 to the Magical Ward save gained from the Blessing of the Lady.

magicItems.name: ORCBANE SHIELD
magicItems.description: Any Orc or Goblin unit within 12" of the model with the Orcbane Shield that must take an Animosity test fails it on a 1-2 instead of a 1.

magicItems.name: IRONSPIKE SHIELD
magicItems.description: Whenever an enemy model rolls a natural 1 To Hit against the bearer of this shield, they immediately suffer a Strength 3 Hit with the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: SIRIENNE'S LOCKET
magicItems.description: A model with Sirienne's Locket has Immunity (Killing Blow, Multiple Wounds) and can never suffer more than one wound in any one phase. After the first wound in that phase is suffered, all subsequent wounds suffered during that phase are ignored. The bearer can still be run down by pursuing enemies as normal, and may still be affected as normal by other "instant kill" attacks.

magicItems.name: HOLY ICON
magicItems.description: The Holy Icon gives the bearer and any unit they are with the Immunity (Psychology) and Magic Resistance (3) special rules.

magicItems.name: INSIGNIA OF THE QUEST
magicItems.description: If the bearer of the Insignia of the Quest is ever reduced to 1 Wound, then the Knight instantly gains a Magical Ward Save (3+) as long as they remain at 1 Wound. If the character suffers an attack that would kill him before he has gained this Ward save (such as Killing Blow or Multiple Wounds), he will be reduced to 1 Wound, then may attempt his Magical Ward (3+) save to stay alive and nullify any further wounds caused by the same hit.

magicItems.name: TOKEN OF THE DAMSEL
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Token of the Damsel ignores the first wounding Hit (after saves) suffered during the game.

magicItems.name: LUCKY HEIRLOOM
magicItems.description: Once per Close Combat phase, the bearer of the Lucky Heirloom can re-roll a single failed roll To Hit or To Wound, or re-roll a failed armour save or Magical Ward save roll.

magicItems.name: MANTLE OF THE DAMSEL ELENA
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Mantle of the Damsel Elena gains the Immunity (Killing Blow, Poisoned Attacks) special rule.

magicItems.name: GRAIL PENDANT
magicItems.description: When the wearer of the Grail Pendant loses their last Wound, roll a D6. On a roll of 2+, the Wound is not lost.

magicItems.name: SACRAMENT OF THE LADY
magicItems.description: The bearer may use the Sacrament of the Lady at the start of any Bretonnian Magic phase. The model adds 2D3 Power Dice to your power pool, but may not cast any spells that turn.

magicItems.name: THE SILVER MIRROR
magicItems.description: When used, the bearer of the Silver Mirror deflects a spell cast at them or the unit they are with back at the enemy caster. The enemy can try to dispel their own spell as normal using any remaining Power dice or Dispel dice. This item has no effect on spells that do not specifically target the bearer or the unit they are with.

magicItems.name: PRAYER ICON OF QUENELLES
magicItems.description: The bearer of Prayer Icon of Quenelles and the unit they are with gain a +1 bonus to the Magical Ward save from the Blessing of the Lady.

magicItems.name: THE VERDANT HEART
magicItems.description: The Verdant Heart gives the bearer a +D3 casting bonus when using the Lore of Life. Roll for each spell casting attempt.

magicItems.name: FLAMESTRIKE WAND
magicItems.description: This item contains the Fires of U'Zhul spell from the Lore of Fire.

magicItems.name: HEART OF THE WILDS
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains a +2 casting bonus if they are wholly within a forest or water terrain feature.

magicItems.name: CHALICE OF MALFLEUR
magicItems.description: At the start of the opponent's Magic phase, the bearer may drink from the Chalice. If they do so, on the roll of a 1 she suffers a wound with no saves allowed, including invulnerable saves. On a roll of 2-6, an extra Dispel dice is added to the player's pool.

magicItems.name: POTION SACRE
magicItems.description: The Potion Sacre can be used before rolling the dice to cast or dispel a spell. After the dice are rolled, the player may add +1 to the result of one dice. This may cause Ultimate Power or prevent a Miscast.

magicItems.name: DIADEM OF POWER
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains a +1 casting bonus when casting magical missiles, direct damage or magical vortex spells.

magicItems.name: THE MANE OF THE PUREBREED
magicItems.description: The Mane of the Purebreed gives +1 Strength to all Warhorses in the unit the model is with.

magicItems.name: THE RUBY GOBLET
magicItems.description: This magic item will start to take effect at the end of the first phase during which the bearer or their unit suffers an unsaved wound. From that moment on, the bearer and any unit they are with cannot be wounded on better than a 3+ from any non-magical source.

magicItems.name: FALCON-HORN OF FREDEMUND
magicItems.description: The Horn may be sounded at the start of any Bretonnian turn. Until the start of your next turn, no enemy unit may use the Fly special rule.

magicItems.name: THE SEAL OF PARRAVON
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Seal of Parravon will always Hit on a 2+ in close combat.

magicItems.name: WYRMBREATH VIAL
magicItems.description: The bearer gains a Breath Weapon attack with Strength 4 and Flaming Attacks and Magical Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: BATTLE STONE OF THE MARQUIS
magicItems.description: The Battle Stone may be used at the start of any close combat phase. The bearer (but not any mount) gains +3 Attacks for this round of close combat.

magicItems.name: CRUSADER'S CLARION
magicItems.description: On a turn in which the bearer of the Crusader's Clarion charge, their mount and all mounts in the unit they have joined may re-roll failed rolls To Wound (including Impact Hits)

magicItems.name: ANTLERS OF THE GREAT HUNT
magicItems.description: The model wearing the Antlers of the Great Hunt and any unit they are with roll an additional dice when pursuing and discard the lowest result.

magicItems.name: CLAW OF MALGRIMACE
magicItems.description: When fighting Monstrous Creatures and Monsters, the bearer may deduct D3 Attacks from his opponent (not including any rider), to a minimum of 1.

magicItems.name: GAUNTLET OF THE DUEL
magicItems.description: Any challenge issued by the bearer of the Gauntlet of the Duel cannot be refused.

magicItems.name: TRESS OF ISOULDE
magicItems.description: Nominate one enemy Character, Monstrous Creature or Monster in base contact at the beginning of any Close Combat phase (after challenges). The bearer automatically hits that model that Close Combat round, regardless of other modifiers.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE LADY'S GRACE
magicItems.description: The unit carrying the Banner of the Lady’s Grace ignores all negative modifiers to its Leadership characteristic.

magicItems.name: THE GRAIL BANNER
magicItems.description: All friendly units within 12" of this standard gain +1 Leadership.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE LADY
magicItems.description: All enemy units in base contact with the bearer of the Banner of the Lady get no combat resolution bonus for ranks.

magicItems.name: CRUSADER'S TAPESTRY
magicItems.description: The unit carrying the Crusader’s Tapestry gains the Frenzy special rule.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF DEFENCE
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard may re-roll failed Magical Ward saves from the Blessing of the Lady against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: CONQUEROR'S TAPESTRY
magicItems.description: The unit carrying the Conqueror's Tapestry gains +1 Combat Resolution Bonus for the remainder of the game for every enemy unit destroyed in close combat or through pursuit.

magicItems.name: ERRANTRY BANNER
magicItems.description: All Knights Errant in the unit get a +1 Strength bonus on any turn they charge. However, a unit with this banner suffers -2 to its Ld for any Impetuous tests.

magicItems.name: TWILIGHT BANNER
magicItems.description: The Twilight Banner can be used at the start of any of your Movement phases. For the remainder of the Movement phase, the unit gains the Ethereal special rule.

magicItems.name: VALOROUS STANDARD
magicItems.description: A unit carrying the Valorous Standard gains the Cold- Blooded special rule.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF HONOURABLE WARFARE
magicItems.description: A unit carrying the Banner of Honourable Warfare may re-roll any failed rolls To Hit during the first round of close combat when engaged with an enemy equipped with any missile weapons.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE ZEALOUS KNIGHT
magicItems.description: The unit carrying the Banner of the Zealous Knight gains the Vanguard special rule.

magicItems.name: BANNERS OF CHALONS
magicItems.description: Enemy units cannot choose Stand & Shoot as a charge reaction against the unit carrying the Banner of Chalons.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF THE LADY
loresOfMagic.attribute: If a spell from the Lore of the Lady is successfully cast on a friendly unit that has the Blessing of the Lady, it may re-roll Magical Ward rolls of 1 until the start of the next Bretonnian Magic phase.

spells.name: THE LADY'S GIFT
spells.description: Remains in Play. The Lady's Gift is an augment spell with a range of 18" that targets a unit with a Chivalrous Vow. While this spell is in effect, the target unit has the Regeneration (6+) special rule.

spells.name: MIST OF CHALONS
spells.description: Mist of Châlons is an augment spell with a range of 18". All missile attacks targeting the unit suffer a -1 To Hit penalty until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: BEGUILEMENT OF BLONDEL
spells.description: Remains in Play. Beguilement of Blondel is a hex spell with a range of 24". While the spell is in effect, the target is subject to the Stupidity special rule.

spells.name: DOOM OF DOL
spells.description: Remains in play. Doom of Dol is a hex spell with a range of 24" that targets a single enemy Character (even a character in a unit) or Lone Model. Choose one friendly character with any Chivalrous Vow in your army. While the spell is active, the chosen Knight will Hit and Wound that enemy model on a 2+ with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

spells.name: STEED OF THE LADY
spells.description: Steed of the Lady is a conveyance spell with a range of 18" that targets Cavalry or Monstrous Cavalry with a Chivalrous Vow. The target may immediately make a normal move as if it were the Remaining Moves sub- phase.

spells.name: THE LADY'S WRATH
spells.description: The Lady's Wrath is an augment spell with a range of 18" that targets a unit with a Chivalrous Vow. The target unit gains +1 Strength (excluding mounts) and the Armour Piercing (1) special rule until the start of your next Magic phase.

spells.name: SHIELD OF THE LADY
spells.description: Shield of the Lady is an augment spell with a range of 18" that targets a unit with a Chivalrous Vow. The target unit may re-roll failed armour saves until the start of your next Magic phase.

spells.name: THE CURSE OF THE LADY
spells.description:
The Curse of the Lady is a hex spell with a range of 12" that targets a single model (even a character in a unit). If the spell is successfully cast, the enemy is turned into a frog. Replace the model with a frog familiar or similar marker. This marker cannot be damaged and does not interfere with other units, simply move it so it is 1" away from all units and impassable terrain in a random direction if needed.
At the start of each enemy turn, the transformed model must take a Leadership test; if successful it is transformed back into its original shape, facing in a random direction. If the test is failed, move the marker D6" in a random direction, stopping within 1" of other units or impassable terrain. If the model is still in its frog form at the end of the game, it is treated as a casualty.

spells.name: CHIVALRIC ONSLAUGHT
spells.description: Chivalric Onslaught is an augment spell with a range of 18" that targets a unit with a Chivalrous Vow. Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, all models in the unit (excluding mounts) gain +1 To Hit and the Devastating Charge special rule.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF HEROISM
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: The Knight has the Heroic Killing Blow special rule.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF STOICISM
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: The Knight (and any unit he has joined) gains the Cold-Blooded special rule.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF THE IDEAL
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: The Knight gains the following bonuses to his profile: +2 Weapon Skill, +1 Initiative, +1 Attack. He may not be the army's General and any friendly unit (including other Knightly characters, or units using a Knight's Leadership) taking any form of Leadership test within 6" of this model suffers a -1 penalty to their Leadership.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF THE IMPETUOUS KNIGHT
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: The Knight, and any mounted unit he is with, adds +D3" to their charge distance.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF AUDACITY
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: Against enemies with a higher Strength than himself (before modifications from weapons etc), the Knight may re-roll any failed rolls to hit and to wound.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF CONFIDENCE
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: The Knight must always issue challenges, and will always accept them if possible. In challenges, the Knight may re-roll all failed rolls to hit and to wound.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF KNIGHTLY TEMPER
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: For each attack that the Knight hits and wounds with on the charge (after Saves), he may make an additional attack. Extra attacks are not generated if these additional attacks also hit and wound.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF DEVOTION
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: The Knight is completely immune to the effects of all enemy spells.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF DUTY
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: For as long as the General is alive, the model with this Virtue adds +1 to the combat resolution of any fight of which he is a part. May not be taken by the General.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF THE PENITENT
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: The Knight has the Stubborn special rule, though he may never join any friendly units.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF THE JOUST
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: The Knight may re-roll failed rolls to hit when charging and/or using a lance (including magical lances).

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF DISCIPLINE
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: Enemies can never claim the Outnumber bonus against the Knight and any unit he is with.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF KNIGHTLY ARDOUR
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: The Knight and unit he is with may choose to Counter- charge as long they distance between them and the enemy is less than the Movement value of the enemy unit, and even if they failed their charge the previous turn.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF NOBLE DISDAIN
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: The Knight Hates all enemies using missile weapons including war machine crews. In addition, any unit the Knight has joined never takes Panic tests caused by suffering 25% casualties from Shooting or Magic.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF PURITY
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: The Knight gains a +1 bonus to their Magical Ward save from the Blessing of the Lady.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF EMPATHY
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: If the Knight is not the army's General, models with the Peasant's Duty within 12" of him treat him as having the Inspiring Presence rule. If he is the army’s General, his Inspiring Presence rule is instead increased to 18" for models with the Peasant's Duty. In addition, he may join units with the Peasant's Duty.

virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.name: VIRTUE OF UTTER SERENTIY
virtues_of_the_chivalric_knight.description: All enemy Wizards within 12" of this Knight suffer -1 casting penalty.
